title: Optimization by decoded quantum interferometry
version: Nature Vol. 646, pp. 831-836 (2025-10-23); published online 2025-10-22; accepted 2025-08-13; received 2024-12-04; local PDF created 2025-10-11
coverage: Read in full and visually verified against PDF pages 1-7 (Nature pp. 831-836): Abstract and max-XORSAT introduction with Eq. (1) on PDF p. 1 (p. 831); 5-step DQI state preparation, Eqs. (2)-(5), Fig. 1, syndrome decoding reduction to dual code C^perp, gate overhead O(T + m^2), Definition 1 (max-LINSAT), and Eq. (6) (semicircle law) on PDF pp. 2-3 (pp. 832-833); Definition 2 (OPI), Figs. 2-3, Reed-Solomon / Berlekamp-Massey reduction, and Prange comparison on PDF p. 3 (p. 833); OPI hardness context, concrete challenge parameters (n/p=1/10 and n/p=r/p=1/2), Qualtran resource estimate at p=521 (~1e8 Toffoli gates, ~9e3 qubits), and sparse max-XORSAT / LDPC / BP vs simulated annealing benchmarks (Table 1) on PDF p. 4 (p. 834); Discussion (Regev reductions, Yamakawa-Zhandry oracle problem, multivariate OPI / Reed-Muller, max-k-XORSAT limits, fair sampling) on PDF p. 5 (p. 835); References [1]-[59] and Data/Code availability on PDF pp. 5-7 (pp. 835-836). External Supplementary Information (Sections 1-13, Supplementary Theorems 1.1 and 7.1) is not included in the 7-page local PDF and was not read directly.
